source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] != background and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != background and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(w):
            out[r][c] = 2
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p=progdir/'task-22825a64.py'
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
